court_name: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH AT AMARAVATI
raw_summary: The High Court of Andhra Pradesh dismissed the criminal appeal filed by the appellant against the judgment of the learned Sessions Judge. The appellant was convicted for offenses under Section 363 IPC, Section 302 IPC, and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012, for kidnapping, murder, and aggravated penetrative sexual assault of a minor girl. The court found the prosecution's case, based on circumstantial evidence including the 'last seen' theory and medical reports, to be proven beyond a reasonable doubt.
